title: Agent Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json manifest files in Agent Plugins 1.0.0 packages.

$schema.description: Schema selector identifying this as an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest.

name.description: Plugin name: 1-64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, and periods; begins and ends alphanumeric.

version.description: Optional plugin release version. Semantic Versioning recommended.

homepage.description: Optional URL for the plugin homepage.

repository.description: Optional URL for the plugin source repository.

license.description: Optional SPDX license identifier or expression.

extensions.description: Optional client-specific extension data, keyed by reverse-domain namespace identifiers.
